VCA: affine branch, centered p−1 dimensions, seed 0. PCA: covariance, no standardization. FCLS: exact small-library simplex-face solver. Native QA and AOI exclusions remain missing; no gap-filled spectra enter the fit.

Geometric extremes can reflect illumination or residual contamination. Fractions and small residuals do not establish physical material abundance. This fit has no independent material validation.

North is up. All four rasters share the reported projected grid. Source and output SHA256, coefficients, selected spectra and assumptions are recorded in the analysis report. This page is a standalone computed showcase; execution is available through the library/CLI.
